description: This file defines a React functional component named NavBar that renders the top navigation bar of a web application. It dynamically adjusts the displayed links based on the user's authentication and authorization status, incorporating links to different routes like '/roles', '/assessment', etc., and conditionally renders admin links if the user has admin privileges.

methods.name: NavBar()
methods.description: React functional component that renders the navigation bar, with links and actions depending on user authentication and admin status.
